g.text: Balanced: b = ceil(c sqrt(9n / (512s))). Normalized: b = floor(k sqrt(n) / s).

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Both clamp b to at least 1. Uniform u64; s = 8 bytes. Representatives fixed before the supplement.

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Bands: full observed range (six time / three heap measurements). All coefficients remain in CSV.
